title: Term of Coverage Provisions for Northgate Care Protection Plans
content:
**1. Term.** Each Northgate Care Protection Plans contract runs for the number of calendar months set for its plan in the table below, counted from the coverage start date.

**2. Coverage start.** For every plan, coverage starts on the covered product's sale date.

**3. Manufacturer's warranty.** For every plan, coverage runs alongside the manufacturer's warranty rather than after it.

**4. Time in repair.** For every plan, time the covered product spends in repair does not extend the coverage end date.

**5. Renewal.** No plan can be renewed or extended at the end of its term.

**6. Change of owner.** Every plan passes to a new owner of the covered product.

## Term schedule

| Plan | Term (calendar months) | Coverage starts on | Runs alongside manufacturer's warranty | Repair time extends term | Renewal or extension offered | Transferable with the product |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | 24 | the product's sale date | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | 36 | the product's sale date | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | 36 | the product's sale date | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | 48 | the product's sale date | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | 36 | the product's sale date | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | 60 | the product's sale date | Yes | No | No | Yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- Because coverage starts on the product's sale date and not on the plan purchase date, a plan bought some days after the product was sold still counts its term from the sale date.
- The four terms in use are 24, 36, 48 and 60 calendar months; three plans share the 36-month term (the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan, the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection and the Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan).
- Hypothetical illustration: a product sold on 2025-06-10 and covered by a Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan bought on 2025-06-25 has a term of 48 calendar months counted from 2025-06-10.
